data.description: Four pechs working together can cast wall of stone once per day.  Eight pechs working together can cast stone to flesh (DC 17) once per day.  These spell-like abilities function at CL 10th.  Each pech must use a full-round action to take part in the casting.  The save DCs are modified by the highest Charisma modifier in the group.
data.name: Pech Magic
